capture.look: natural social-feed smartphone lifestyle photograph with quiet art direction
capture.realism: natural hand anatomy, ordinary wall, believable sunlight

color.contrast: restrained direct-sun contrast, only very slightly firmer than v3

composition.alignment: one smaller held cup slightly off center, supported by a slender fine-boned hand against a distant wall
composition.camera_angle: eye-level to slightly-above, two-to-six degrees downward only
composition.camera_height: approximately one hundred thirty to one hundred sixty centimeters
composition.depth_of_field: cup and hand resolve in one near focal plane; the wall is physically distant and moderately softer with attenuated texture

display_name: 인스타 에디토리얼 · 화이트 직사광 핸드헬드 · 정제 비율 v5
failure_recovery: return product width to 0.16-0.20 and height to 0.23-0.29
increase camera working distance to 105-145cm while preserving 45-55mm normal-lens geometry
rebuild one slender fine-boned hand with a narrower palm, tapered fingers and fine natural skin lines
if and only if the adopted container includes a straw, make it colorless optically clear plastic with neutral transmitted light; otherwise add no straw
keep camera pitch at 2-6 degrees downward and the wall 100-180cm behind
retain the reviewed 1.10 contrast without crushing skin, beverage or wall tone

forbidden: broad rugged palm or oversized hand
thick swollen fingers or coarse knuckles
hairy, callused or heavily weathered forearm
human_presence.grip: light plausible lower-side grip with small pressure changes and relaxed unequal finger spacing; palm width remains modest relative to the cup
human_presence.hand_style: one slender fine-boned adult hand with a narrower palm, naturally tapered fingers, subtle knuckle structure, fine skin lines and slight real color variation; refined proportions without beauty smoothing
human_presence.nails: short neat natural nails with thin ordinary edges, no polish and no rendered gloss
human_presence.wrist_and_clothing: only a very short bare wrist segment; no sleeve, cuff or long forearm

lighting.contrast: moderate direct-sun separation, only very slightly firmer than v3
lighting.highlight_control: preserve transparent cup detail and avoid blown wall highlights
lighting.shadow: clearly defined diagonal hand and cup shadow falling lower-left

editable: wall, sun patch and connected shadow
hard_lock: beverage recipe, color, temperature and ice state
source cup design semantics reconstructed under the target sun and grip
one natural hand and short bare wrist
reference_exclusions: source street, hand, clothing and lighting
exact reference hand pose or sun patch

prompt_blocks.composition: Render one smaller handheld product at width 0.16-0.20 and height 0.23-0.29 with an eye-level to slightly-above camera pitched downward only 2-6 degrees. Support it with one slender fine-boned natural hand and short bare wrist. Keep the wall 100-180cm behind.
prompt_blocks.input_roles: Image one supplies exact product identity. Image two is a sanitized sleeve-free scene hint supplying only hand-cup topology, scale, distant-wall depth and broad off-frame light map; it supplies no reference brand, beverage or exact hand pixels.
prompt_blocks.look: Casual Instagram-native direct-window photograph with a smaller hand-cup unit, refined natural hand proportions, real optical depth, distant wall, broad off-frame shadows, finite phone texture and the reviewed +2 percent contrast.
prompt_blocks.negative: No oversized cup, broad rugged hand, thick fingers, coarse knuckles, low or upward camera, visible cup underside, holder, sleeve, long forearm, waxy skin, sharp wall, colored or metallic straw, flat studio fill, pasted edge or invented text.
prompt_blocks.preservation: Reconstruct the cup and beverage natively for the new grip, camera and direct light. Never paste, trace or preserve source pixels. Obey the serving and target brand contracts.

quality_gates.artifact_policy: reject product enlargement, broad rugged palm, thick swollen fingers, coarse knuckles, colored/gray/green/metallic straw, invented straw when source policy says none, upward camera, holder, waxy skin, sharp close wall, clipped wall, pasted edge or wrong serving
quality_gates.logo_text: only the target brand contract is authoritative; unbranded targets remain unbranded
quality_gates.preset_adherence: one smaller product at width 0.16-0.20 and height 0.23-0.29, one slender fine-boned hand, 2-6 degree downward camera, neutral-clear conditional straw and distant wall agree
quality_gates.product_identity: one beverage preserves recipe and serving state while cup optics are reconstructed

capture_primitives: natural skin texture and short bare wrist
composition_primitives: one held drink near frame center
hand enters only from the lower edge
copy_exclusions: specific hand pose and sun-patch shape
lighting_primitives: broad softened wall-shadow falloff separated from the near hand-cup plane
partial off-frame window and furniture tone variation with protected whites
reference_analysis.runtime_role: offline composition and light extraction only

runtime_input_policy.copyright_rule: Generate an original handheld moment; never reproduce the source reference's cup, branding, hand pose or exact sun patch.

asymmetry_sources: the straw direction when the user's product has a straw
micro_moments: raising the drink toward a window
checking the drink in a patch of sunlight
pov_modes: eye-level to slightly-above handheld observation with a mild downward pitch

scene.background: one warm-white interior plaster wall one hundred to one hundred eighty centimeters behind the held product, moderately softer than the focal plane
scene.texture: natural hand creases and pressure, cup optics, distant softened plaster, broad off-frame shadow variation and subtle shared sensor texture

tone_contract.background_plane: distant warm-white plaster wall with attenuated texture, gradual tonal drift and broad partial shadows from unseen window and furniture
tone_contract.color_bias: clean warm white with a faint neutral gray cast, never brown or concrete gray
tone_contract.highlight_behavior: sunlit wall remains bright with visible fine plaster texture and no clipped white patch
